aboutPsychologist.title: What is a psychologist and why you might need one
aboutPsychologist.lead: A psychologist helps people make sense of emotions, behavior, and relationships.
aboutPsychologist.paragraph1: A psychologist is not a doctor and does not prescribe medication. They create a safe space where a child can express feelings, learn to understand themselves, and find ways to cope with difficulties such as anxiety, fears, conflicts with peers or family, low self-esteem, and challenges with learning and motivation.
aboutPsychologist.paragraph2: For parents, a psychologist helps see what lies behind "difficult" behavior or moodiness, how to support the child, and how to build trusting relationships. Working together with the family often leads to the most lasting results.

personalExperience.title: Personal experience and path into the profession
personalExperience.lead: I came to psychology from a desire to help people, and especially children, feel understood and accepted.
personalExperience.short: I work in humanistic and cognitive-behavioral approaches: I rely on a warm connection and clear, evidence-based methods. I regularly attend supervision and training to remain a reliable support for families and children.

workWithChildren.title: Areas of work with children
workWithChildren.lead: Four areas in which I support children and families. Pick the one that matches your child's age.

childPsychologist.title: Child psychologist (any age)
childPsychologist.description: Consultations and sessions for children: anxiety, fears, aggression, difficulties in communication, low self-esteem, adaptation to kindergarten or school, coping with divorce or family conflict. I work through play and conversation, and involve parents when needed.

childDevelopment.title: Child development (ages 2-5)
childDevelopment.description: Early childhood development: speech, thinking, attention, memory, and fine motor skills through play. We track age norms, build on the child's strengths, and gently support the areas that are still developing.

schoolPrep.title: School preparation (ages 5-7)
schoolPrep.description: Comprehensive preparation for 1st grade: developing attention, memory, thinking, and the ability to follow rules. I help the child ease into a school routine and reduce anxiety about starting school.

tutor.title: Tutor (grades 5-9)
tutor.description: Support for students in grades 5-9: organizing study time, planning, developing independence and motivation. I help with workload, stress, and difficulties with teachers or classmates so that learning becomes conscious and manageable.
